rl_lampman.name: Drowned Lampman
rl_lampman.desc: One of the keeper's lamp-tenders, drowned at his post and still in his oilskin apron. He carries a hook for lifting lamps that are no longer there, and he wants yours.

rl_heronling.name: Heronling
rl_heronling.desc: A young heron out of the tower's nest, all knees and neck, with a cold glitter in its eyes from the glass it was fed. It stabs at your lantern as if it were a fish.

rl_heron.name: The Lens-Eyed Heron
rl_heron.desc: A heron as tall as a man, grey on grey, standing as still as a keeper at a window. Where a pupil should be, a sliver of the great lens burns with a light that is not your lantern's, and she is looking for a ship.

moves.name: Gulp
moves.tell: draws back her head and opens her throat

moves.name: Lens Flare
moves.tell: turns her eye to the lantern

phases.msg: The lens in her eye catches your lantern and holds it, like a lighthouse seeing its first ship in fifty years.

moves.name: Gulp

moves.name: Lens Flare

moves.name: Beacon Stare
moves.tell: fixes the lens in her eye on your lantern
